final_message:
The failing test has been fixed. The issue was in the `wrap` function in `src/wrap.py`. The condition `len(cur) + extra > width - 1` was incorrectly checking against `width - 1` instead of `width`, which caused text that exactly fit within the specified width to be split unnecessarily.

The fix changed the condition from `> width - 1` to `> width`, so that when the text would exactly fill the width (no room for a space), it stays on the same line.

All 5 tests now pass.
